# BLAZIN IPTV Player Support

Thank you for using **BLAZIN IPTV Player**.

## Report a bug

Use the repository's **Issues** section for reproducible problems with BLAZIN IPTV Player. Please use the Bug Report template and provide enough information to reproduce the issue.

Before reporting a bug, make sure you are using the latest version available from the Microsoft Store.

## Questions and help

Use **GitHub Discussions** for usage questions, setup help, troubleshooting questions, and general discussion about BLAZIN IPTV Player.

**Discussions:** https://github.com/Cyogenus/Blazin-IPTV-Player-Windows/discussions

## Protect your account information

Never post IPTV usernames, passwords, portal credentials, MAC addresses, private playlist URLs, subscription details, or other sensitive account information in an Issue or Discussion.

## IPTV service support

BLAZIN IPTV Player is a media player. It does not provide IPTV subscriptions, channels, playlists, or streaming services. Questions about a provider's service, account, channel availability, or subscription should be directed to that provider.

## Feature requests

Public feature requests are not currently being accepted. Development priorities and the product roadmap are managed by the BLAZIN IPTV Player developer.
